admission_details.quote: Students seeking Admission to the pre-licensure nursing program (BSN) have four pathways: … First-time freshmen who declare nursing and meet all three milestones in three continuous (full-time) semesters will be admitted into … the nursing program in their fourth semester (this may occur sooner depending upon … Must meet these requirements to declare a nursing major when entering freshman year … High School GPA of 3.5 or higher (per the TN Uniform Grading Policy and GPA calculation),
admission_details.criteria_text: First-time freshmen may declare nursing with a high school GPA of 3.5 or higher (or GED 660 / HiSET 75), a B or better in high school biology and college-level placement; those who meet all three semester milestones are admitted into the nursing program in their fourth semester. Others apply through academic candidacy.
paths: first-time freshman candidacy (milestones, admitted in the fourth semester)
